item.title: What We Know About the US Fighter Jet Shot Down by Iran
item.summary: It was the first enemy downing of an American warplane during the war with Iran. The F-15E Strike Eagle was carrying two crew members, who ejected, officials said.

item.title: Iran Is Quickly Repairing Missile Bunkers, U.S. Intelligence Says
item.summary: Reports cast doubt on how close the United States is to destroying Iran’s missile capability, a key goal in the war.

item.title: The F-15E Strike Eagle: What to Know
item.summary: The U.S. military aircraft with a two-person crew was shot down in Iran on Friday.

item.title: Kuwait Blames Iran for Attack on Power and Desalination Plants
item.summary: In Kuwait, an Iranian attack on Friday damaged a power and water desalination plant, officials said. Both sides in the Iran war have ramped up strikes on civilian targets.

item.title: At War With Iran Again, Some Israelis Fear Conflict Is Becoming Routine
item.summary: A majority of Israelis support the war with Iran, but many doubt that it will solve Israel’s long-term security problems. Some also question their prime minister’s assurances and motives.

item.title: Trump’s Strait of Hormuz Problem
item.summary: Our White House reporter Zolan Kanno-Youngs parses some of President Trump’s conflicting messages about the war with Iran.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Thursday
item.summary: President Trump’s prime-time address received a defiant response from a top leader in Tehran.

item.title: Macron Voices Europe’s Frustration With Trump’s Handling of Iran War
item.summary: President Emmanuel Macron of France expressed disapproval about President Trump’s handling of the war against Iran on Thursday, chastising him for speaking cavalierly in a speech.

item.title: Iranians hold a nature festival in the shadow of war.
Trump Hails Strike on Iranian Bridge, Warning ‘More to Follow’
item.summary: Iran state media said eight people had been killed in the attack and dozens wounded. A local official said the bridge, in the mountains, was not yet in operation and that the people had been nearby when the attack happened.
